Run the ACWR Shiny app

Source: R/run_app.R
run_app.Rd

Launches an interactive Shiny app (in English, for teaching) to compute and plot the ACWR and the Footballer Workload Footprint of an athlete, from an uploaded file or from preloaded datasets.

Usage

run_app(...)

Arguments

...

arguments passed to shiny::runApp(), e.g. launch.browser or port.

Value

called for its side effect (it starts the app); does not return until the app is closed.

Details

All the values shown by the app are computed with the functions of this package (RAC(), RAU(), EWMA(), fwf_cumulative() and fwf_delta()), on the same daily calendar.

Uploaded CSV files need a date (or numeric day) column and a load column, and may have an athlete_id column and extra numeric variables (used for the FWF). The Spanish column names fecha, dia, carga and atleta are accepted as aliases.

     The app needs the packages shiny, bslib, ggplot2, plotly, DT
     and writexl. They are not installed with ACWR;
     `run_app()` says which ones are missing.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  run_app()
}
